## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 581 captures during May 2026. This provides the activity total for the month and confirms that imaging was undertaken at the site throughout the reporting period. The recorded volume is presented for operational review and should be considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 12 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 2.1 of captures. These results are reported separately from the grading outcomes to distinguish image-quality limitations from findings identified through the grading process. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 168 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. This is the median interval reported for grading during May 2026. The activity, image-quality, and grading figures together provide the site-level position for North City Eye Clinic for the month. The figures should be retained for routine operational monitoring and comparison with subsequent site reports.
